desc:
Before 2017, this double approach was considered to be big, as it threatens to fully surround Black at <B:P15>, and White was preferred. Modern AI evaluates it with less sente value, suggesting that Black can play other big opening points (such as pressing down on a 3-4 point) before answering directly. See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 8, AlphaGo Master (W) vs. Han Yizhou 5p (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVmQ15D1pHs&t=77s).

<A:Q14> was played 99% of the time in 2019.

[Explanation by Go Pro Yeonwoo on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/GF2FWf8PbKE?si=FLGPTbOCums8ukOG)
